name: Nightingale Rose
summary: An engraved, Victorian polar-area rose where three wedges after 09:42 fall short of the dotted norm.
look: Aged sepia paper, dashed scale rings and hairline ink, teal rose petals separated by paper gutters; the anomaly wedges are coral inside dashed norm outlines. Letter-spaced serif titles like an 1850s statistical atlas.

components.name: Rose wedge
components.role: polar-area slice, radius = value, paper gutters between petals

components.name: Scale rings
components.role: dashed concentric circles so length is readable

components.name: Norm ghost
components.role: dashed wedge outline showing the expected value

components.name: Clock labels
components.role: mono :00 / :15 / :30 or hour ticks around the rim

components.name: Engraved title
components.role: letter-spaced serif caps with a hairline rule, 1850s atlas style

components.name: Leader + note
components.role: ink elbow line to a serif marginal note

motion.name: Clockwise bloom
motion.how: wedge radius 0 → value with power2.out 0.3 s, staggered 0.125 s (16ths at 120 BPM) around the dial

motion.name: Petal equalise
motion.how: all radii tween to one length with expo.inOut 0.5 s landing on the drop; hue sweeps clockwise over 1 beat

motion.name: Short wedge
motion.how: anomaly wedges stop 20 % short with back.in(1.2) 0.25 s on the snare; dashed norm draws around them

story: Hook: a messy sepia rose of dashboard checks by the hour. Drop: petals equalise into a teal flower around the Acme mark. Proof: an hour of checkout conversion, the wedges since 09:42 fall short in coral after deploy #2231, −18%, Roll back. CTA: a small even teal rose, Every metric. Every minute., Start free.
adapt: Any cyclical metric (hours of a day, days of a week, minutes of an hour) works as a rose; swap in your own cycle and show the anomaly as wedges that fall short of their dashed expected shape.

references.note: polar area / coxcomb chart definition and Nightingale's 1858 diagram

fit.risk: Polar areas exaggerate outer changes and the Victorian styling can feel academic; keep the ring scale visible and the headline modern.
